Rebuild Collagen. Book Your Radiesse Consultation What is Radiesse? RADIESSE uses an ingredient that is also naturally found in your body to regenerate collagen, elastin, and other key proteins by activating skin’s natural pathway for self-renewal. It’s called calcium hydroxylapatite. RADIESSE renews skin quality and restores natural contour in the areas where you may notice signs of aging—the lower face, hands, and jawline. Download Patient Guides RADIESSE® and RADIESSE® (+) are dermal fillers that are used for smoothing moderate to severe facial wrinkles and folds, such as nasolabial folds (the creases that extend from the corner of your nose to the corner of your mouth). RADIESSE® is also used for correcting volume loss in the back of the hands and, when diluted with saline to smooth away wrinkles such as those in the décolleté in patients 22 years of age and older. RADIESSE® (+) is also used for improving moderate to severe loss of jawline contour in adults over 21 years old. Radiesse Is A Biostimulator Injectable That Restores Lost Volume, Enhances Facial Structure, And Stimulates Natural Collagen Production For Firmer, Smoother, More Youthful-Looking Skin. How it works Radiesse is made with calcium hydroxylapatite, also known as CaHA. Once injected, it provides immediate volume and lift while also stimulating your body’s natural collagen production over time. As new collagen forms, the skin becomes firmer, smoother, and more structurally supported. This dual-action approach allows for both instant improvement and long-term skin rejuvenation. Why we love it! Radiesse Biostimulators offer multiple benefits: Restores lost volume and facial contours Stimulates natural collagen production Improves skin firmness and elasticity Provides natural-looking, long-lasting results Non-surgical with minimal downtime Injectables Collagen Support Volume Restoration Before & After Questions? We’ve Got Answers: HOW MANY TREATMENTS WILL I NEED? Every individual is different and will require a different amount of treatments based on their aesthetic goals. Most patients will start to notice a difference after their second treatment, and patients may receive up to 6 treatments total spaced a month apart. Studies show that 59% of patients who received Kybella received 6 treatments. IS THERE ANY DOWN TIME? Radiesse treatments typically involve minimal downtime. You may experience temporary swelling, redness, or bruising at the injection site, which usually resolves within a few days. WHAT ARE BIOSTIMULATORS? Biostimulators are injectable treatments designed to stimulate your body’s natural collagen production. Instead of only adding volume, they improve skin quality, firmness, and structure over time. WHEN WILL I SEE RESULTS? You will notice immediate improvement after treatment due to added volume. Over the following weeks, results continue to improve as collagen production increases, creating more natural and long-lasting outcomes. What Are Your Skin Or Body Concerns?
